julesThoughtProcess: I chose Mint Green (#00FFAA) to reflect the organic growth within a technological space, matching the visible plant and the theme of grounded optimism. The story focuses on the quiet, essential work of maintaining the infrastructure that connects people.
storyPanel: Amidst the hum of server farms and the hydroponic gardens, technicians maintain the local data node. The work is physically demanding, pulling cables through tight industrial ducts, but the quiet camaraderie and the smell of ozone mixed with fresh foliage make it worthwhile. Every restored connection brings the sprawling community closer.
